column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3600): the registry, override-record and upgrade-window tests run one subtest per dialect through testutil.TestDB, which skips when its DSN is unset. Measured by NAME, not by delta, with only the named database configured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL go test ./engine/ -run '^(TestThePluginNameRegistryOutlivesTheWorkerRow|TestARegistrationWithAnUnrecordablePluginNameRegistersNothing|TestTheApplicationRoleCannotDeleteFromThePluginNameRegistry|TestBeforeTheFirstUpgradedWorkerStartsADeclaredPluginIsRefused|TestAnOverrideIsRecordedInADurableRow|TestTheApplicationRoleCanOnlyAppendToTheOverrideRecord)\$' -count=1 -json reports skip for exactly the mssql and mysql arms (8), and the postgres arms and TestARegistrationWithAnUnrecordablePluginNameRegistersNothing RUN. One line per test, in a shape scripts/check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py parses (a literal name plus a subtest suffix); the same regexes under test-go/engine and cluster, byte for byte.
